qa_pairs.question: What kind of resource usage can be monitored under the "Usage of local disk space" section?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the "Usage of local disk space" section, users can monitor the utilization of local disk resources, providing insight into their consumed storage.

qa_pairs.question: What is the primary focus of the "Usage of local disk space" section within the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Within the Metrix portal, the "Usage of local disk space" section primarily focuses on tracking the amount of local disk space being used.
